headline: Teknaf: Doctor abducted at gunpoint from home
summary: Armed men stormed a residence in Teknaf, kidnapping a physician during broad daylight.
details: A doctor was abducted at gunpoint from his home in Teknaf, Cox's Bazar, during the day.
According to reports, armed individuals entered the residence and forced the physician to leave with them.
Local authorities have been notified of the incident, and efforts to locate the victim are underway.
The identity of the kidnappers and their motive for the abduction remain unknown at this time.

headline_marked: 6 newborns killed: [[Ad-din Hospital license suspended]] over negligence
headline: 6 newborns killed: Ad-din Hospital license suspended over negligence
summary: The Health Minister stated in Parliament that oxygen shortage and extreme negligence led to the deaths of six infants.
details: The Health Minister informed Parliament that six newborns died at Ad-din Hospital due to extreme negligence and a lack of oxygen.
As a result, the government has suspended the hospital's license to restore discipline in healthcare services.
The Minister also criticized Jamaat-e-Islami for defending the hospital despite the tragic loss of lives.
The suspension serves as a warning to other medical facilities to ensure patient safety and quality care.
caption:
6 newborns died due to oxygen shortage and negligence. Now, the government has suspended Ad-din Hospital's license.

The Health Minister informed Parliament that six newborns died at Ad-din Hospital due to extreme negligence and a lack of oxygen.

As a result, the government has suspended the hospital's license to restore discipline in healthcare services.

The Minister also criticized Jamaat-e-Islami for defending the hospital despite the tragic loss of lives.

The suspension serves as a warning to other medical facilities to ensure patient safety and quality care.

#Bangladesh #HealthCare #MedicalNegligence #AdDinHospital #Justice

Source: Prothom Alo, Dhaka Tribune
